transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. I understand we have a patient on the cardiology service ready for discharge today. Before we finalize the paperwork, I'd like to do our routine plan review. Could the floor nurse and clinic scheduler join me to confirm the follow-up appointment details and any discharge instructions that need to be documented? I want to make sure we get this patient seen again within this same week after discharge, and we can decide whether an in-person clinic visit or a video visit will work best and safely for them.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: During discharge teaching this morning, the patient told me they become short of breath after walking from the parking lot to the clinic entrance, and they asked for a wheelchair escort if they have to come in person.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to flag something important about the scheduling. The only same-week in-person cardiology slot still open is Thursday at 8:00 a.m., but wheelchair escort service for that clinic doesn't start until 8:30 a.m. — so there's a mismatch there. The only same-week slot that avoids that problem is a video visit on Friday at 2:00 p.m. Given what Elena just shared about the patient needing a wheelchair escort for in-person visits, I'd recommend we go with the Friday 2:00 p.m. video visit to keep things safe and avoid the escort timing issue.
